chairman.name: Prof. Dr. Rezaul Karim
message: Welcome to the Department of Journalism and Media Studies at Port City International University. In today's digital age, the role of media professionals has become more important than ever in shaping public opinion and disseminating information.

Our department is committed to producing skilled journalists and media professionals who uphold the highest standards of ethics, accuracy, and responsibility. Our curriculum combines theoretical knowledge with practical training in print, broadcast, and digital media.

With state-of-the-art media labs and experienced faculty from both academia and industry, we prepare students to become successful journalists, broadcasters, content creators, and media managers in Bangladesh's dynamic media landscape.

content: The Department of Journalism and Media Studies offers comprehensive programs combining theoretical knowledge with practical training in print, broadcast, and digital media.
